_README: WORKING ASSUMPTION, not a design basis. Resolves M4 Rev B OI-4.5 for the purpose of letting the grouping factor resolve. Replace with the real AU04 layout before any issued design.
_why_it_matters: AS/NZS 3008.1.1:2025 Table 3.34 has separate axes for 'number of rows or tiers' and 'number of circuits per tier or row'. Three circuits read as one row of three takes 0.87; read as three rows of one it takes 0.93. A 7 % swing on every grouped feeder.

assumption.reading: one row per tray, circuits counted across the row
assumption.note: R-GRP-1b requires at least 300 mm vertical pitch between horizontal trays for Table 3.34 to apply at all; below that the table does not apply and the engine raises.

status: EXAMPLE. Confirm against the real tray layout before issue.
